title: Gudrun's Ring
offer: My mother's ring! It slipped from my finger into the lake, by the jetty. Gone forever... unless a fisher's net caught it? Ask Ragna.

steps.say: A ring? Wait... Tor found something shiny in our net yesterday! Ask him in Stormvik.

steps.load_say: This? Silver with a little red stone. I thought it was a fish's treasure!
steps.say: My mother's ring! Back from the lake! I can not thank you enough. Every meal at my inn is free for you.

reward.gift: free meals at the inn of Vargvik

fact: Vikings sometimes gave silver to the lakes on purpose, as gifts to the gods.
